newsitem.title: PANAMA: Ecuador's Bucaram back in Panama.
newsitem.headline: Ecuador's Bucaram back in Panama.

text.p: Ousted Ecuadorean President Abdala Bucaram has returned to Panama at the end of a regional tour to win support and denounce the "coup d'etat" that he said toppled him this month.
Bucaram, who arrived from neighbouring Colombia on Monday night, was to meet in private with Panama's President Ernesto Perez Balladares on Tuesday, a presidential spokesman said.

It was not immediately known how long Bucaram, who was dismissed by Ecuador's Congress on Feb. 6 on grounds of "mental incompetence," would stay in Panama. Foreign Minister Ricardo Arias said the former leader "is welcome in Panama," where he lived in exile from 1985-90 after he fled Ecuador when he was charged with corruption as mayor of Guayaquil.
